title: What are the odds of a white Christmas where you live?
excerpt: Every Christmas Day from 1940 to 2025 in 116 UK towns. Snow lay on about 1 in 11, from never in Bournemouth to most years in the Highlands, and white Christmases arrive in a few big years.
seo_description: How often has there been snow on Christmas Day in your town? 116 UK towns, every Christmas from 1940 to 2025, from weather reanalysis.
header_alt: Title card on pale paper reading 'What are the odds of a white Christmas where you live?' beside a map of 116 UK towns shaded from pale to deep blue by how often snow lay on Christmas Day.
